description.value:
AC +2. Granting an ally temporary HP gives you critical damage bonus +3 for 2 turns. Your follow-up forces a Constitution save; on failure, the target takes +1 allied hit damage for 2 turns.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching preservation Path required.
